description: This file defines the IManagementGrain interface for system management functions of Orleans silos, including methods for retrieving cluster and silo statistics, managing activations, and controlling providers. It also includes the GrainCallFrequency struct for estimating grain call frequencies.

classes.name: GrainCallFrequency
classes.description: Represents an estimation of the frequency of calls made from a source grain to a target grain, including source/target grains and hosts, and call count.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of silo hosts and their statuses, optionally filtering for only active silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed membership information about silo hosts, optionally filtering for only active silos.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers a .NET garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Triggers activation collection on specified silos with an age limit.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Triggers runtime statistics collection on specified silos.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated simple grain statistics across silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed grain statistics, filtered by types and silos.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Gets the activation count for a specific grain reference.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Gets the total number of grain activations across all silos.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Executes a control command on specified providers across silos.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Returns the silo address where a given grain is activated.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Returns all active grains of a specified type.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Estimates grain call frequencies from specified hosts.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets grain call frequency counts on specified hosts for testing.
